visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with light brown hair and glasses, wearing a black "aide garage" hoodie, sits in the driver's seat of a vehicle. He speaks expressively to someone off-camera, gesturing with his hands while the car appears to be in motion through the window. (2) The scene shifts to a silver Mercedes-Benz C-Class elevated on a hydraulic lift inside a spacious industrial garage. Tools, storage cabinets, and various car parts are visible in the background under bright artificial lighting. (3) The host returns to the car interior, laughing heartily and holding his chin while talking. The camera captures him in a medium shot. (4) Back in the garage, the host stands under the elevated Mercedes holding a light-blue polka-dot umbrella. He points toward the floor where dark oil spots have accumulated on the concrete. (5) Close-up shots reveal the car's undercarriage and engine bay, which are heavily coated in dark, viscous oil, indicating a significant leak. (6) The host is joined by a mechanic wearing a black jacket and a headlamp. They both lean over the open engine compartment, with the host pointing at specific components while discussing the vehicle's condition.
